relationships.justification: Article 0004 amplifies negative sentiment for Tesla stock by calling it a 'bubble', following earlier 'bad news' for investors in article 0001.
Article 0005's report of a 'profit outlook tanks' amplifies the negative sentiment from the Q4 2025 earnings preview in article 0007.
Article 0008 provides a recap of Tesla's earnings and Musk's announcements, which were previewed in article 0007.
Article 0010 amplifies the importance of the Optimus robot (mentioned by Musk in article 0008) as a potential stock driver.
Article 0013, reporting Tesla's ownership in SpaceX, amplifies the theme of Musk's ecosystem integration suggested by his announcements in article 0008.
Article 0014 further amplifies the bullish sentiment around Optimus robot production, following article 0010's prediction of stock doubling due to Optimus.
Article 0016, published later, reiterates and provides details of the UK sales plunge and stock drop initially indicated by root_origin.
Article 0016 reports a more significant stock drop and provides the specific reason (UK sales plunge) for the general plunge reported earlier in article 0015.
Article 0018 connects the falling stock (as detailed in 0016) to the urgent need for Optimus, amplifying the negative pressure on current stock performance.
Article 0022 amplifies the negative sales narrative (initially UK in 0016) by reporting Volkswagen topping broader Europe EV sales, contributing to stock slides.
Article 0020 reports Cathie Wood buying Tesla stock during a price tumble, directly countering the negative sentiment of the plunging stock reported in article 0015.
Article 0021 counters the negative trend of falling stock prices (e.g., in 0015) by highlighting a 'strategic buying opportunity'.
Article 0026 amplifies the 'Europe sales warnings' first highlighted in article 0022 as a factor for Tesla's stock slide.
Article 0028 reports Tesla stock jumping later the same day, countering the early day slide and negative impact of the 'China AI training report' mentioned in article 0026.
Article 0028 amplifies the positive end-of-week stock performance reported in article 0027, adding more detail and context.
Article 0031 amplifies the positive stock trend reported in article 0028 and reinforces the 'China AI plan' as a driving factor.
Article 0029 amplifies the bullish implications of 'Musk Ecosystem Integration', a theme established by the SpaceX link-up in article 0013.
Article 0032 amplifies the importance of SpaceX for Elon Musk's long-term financial ambitions, building on the news of Tesla owning a piece of SpaceX in article 0013.
Article 0006 provides another forecast for Tesla's share price for 2026, amplifying the discussion on future outlook initiated by article 0002.
Article 0009 offers another stock price prediction for 2026-2030, further amplifying the forecasts discussed in article 0006.
Article 0011 amplifies the theme of future predictions from article 0009 by presenting specific, albeit conflicting, analyst price targets.
Article 0017 amplifies the ongoing discussion about Tesla's future valuation and Wall Street's expectations, building on the analyst predictions in article 0011.
